canonical_project: Microsoft/G42 Olkaria geothermal data center campus
owner: G42 with Microsoft and local partners
notes: Microsoft's May 22, 2024 announcement says G42 and partners would design and build a geothermal-powered Olkaria data center campus for a new East Africa Azure cloud region. Later DCD reporting says the project targeted an initial 100MW but had stalled over power capacity/contract issues and remained in discussions, possibly scaled back. G42/EcoCloud also announced an Olkaria mega data center collaboration with initial 100MW and potential expansion to 1GW.
